all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: card_divisors_mul_le
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem card_divisors_mul_le (q r : ℕ) :
    (q * r).divisors.card ≤ q.divisors.card * r.divisors.card

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: sum_gamma_tau_div_totient_le
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem sum_gamma_tau_div_totient_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
      ‖d.groupedFactorGamma q‖ * (q.divisors.card : ℝ) / (q.totient : ℝ)) ≤
        (1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap) ^ 12

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: sum_gamma_norm_le
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem sum_gamma_norm_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ‖d.groupedFactorGamma q‖) ≤
      d.physicalFactorCap * (1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap) ^ 2

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: actualU_finite_envelope_le
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actualU_finite_envelope_le
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    (∑ q ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli, ∑ r ∈ d.physicalFactorModuli,
      ‖primitivePairCoefficient d q r‖ * ((q * r).divisors.card : ℝ)) ≤
        4 * d.U ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap) ^ 24

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: actualU_sub_primitive_bound
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actualU_sub_primitive_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
      ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionU d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
        d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
          C * d.U ^ 2 * (1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap) ^ 24

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: actual_betaL2_mul_U_error_bound
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem actual_betaL2_mul_U_error_bound :
    ∃ C : ℝ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (B : ℕ) (sigma kappa c0 : ℝ) (d : MediumAtom),
      MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d →
      (∑ n ∈ d.betaCarrier, ‖d.beta n‖ ^ 2) *
        ‖(d.transposedAtom.complexDispersionU d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothCarrier
          d.transposedAtom.commonSmoothWeight : ℂ) - primitiveZeroMain d‖ ≤
            C * d.V * d.U ^ 2 *
              (1 + Real.log (2 * d.V)) ^ ((2 ^ B) ^ 2 - 1) *
                (1 + Real.log d.physicalFactorCap) ^ 24

all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.name: U_sq_lt_scale_rpow
all_complete_source_headers_and_definiti.complete_source_header:
theorem U_sq_lt_scale_rpow
    {B : ℕ} {sigma kappa c0 : ℝ} {d : MediumAtom}
    (hd : MediumAdmissible B sigma kappa c0 d) :
    d.U ^ 2 < d.scale ^ (1 - 8 * sigma)

independent_semantic_findings: For positive q,r, every divisor of q*r factors as a divisor of q times a divisor of r. For a zero factor the relevant divisor sets are empty. The stated pointwise product-cardinality inequality is valid without positivity assumptions.
The true grouped factor gamma is bounded by tau_3, not by one. Its product with the ordinary divisor coefficient tau_2 is bounded by tau_6; the existing real totient-weighted moment pays exponent 12.
Both literal alpha coprime masses cost 2U, so the finite U error costs 4 U^2 times the square of that moment, exactly log exponent 24. This coefficient envelope is derived as a conclusion.

The already proved uniform smooth coprime error supplies a single constant before B, sigma, kappa, c0 and d. Multiplying by the true original beta L2 costs 2V and the full fixed-B divisor-square logarithm.
U^2 < X^(1-8sigma) is actually derived from the existing U^2*Q2*Q3^2 medium gate and Q2,Q3>=1. No new size gate is assumed. Log absorption and the full dispersion/nonzero endpoint are not claimed.
